title.zh: 接合检验随同一编码保真
title.en: Joining questions remain exact under the same encoding

claim.zh: 将问题中每个接合伙伴按同一说明编码后，在诱导多结果接合关系内解释所得问题，答案与原问题相同。
claim.en: After encoding every joining partner in a question through the same account, interpreting the translated question in the induced multivalued joining relation gives exactly the original answer.

hypotheses.zh: 同一部分接合 J；每对输入具有有限结果集合。
hypotheses.en: One partial joining relation J; each input pair has a finite outcome set.

hypotheses.zh: 目标含全部有限否定、合取、左右接合后继问题，无独立原子谓词。
hypotheses.en: The target contains all finite negation, conjunction and left/right joining-successor questions, with no independent atomic predicates.

hypotheses.zh: Exact 给出完整精确答案；Reduced 仅用于最小代码与输出代码的提升。
hypotheses.en: Exact supplies complete truthful answers; Reduced is used for minimal codes and lifting output codes.

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

detail.zh: 代表片段一致的输出提升接入复合结构。
detail.en: Representative-wise output lifting feeds the compound structure.

output.zh: 每个编码输出可由指定输入对实现。
output.en: Every code outcome is realizable by the specified input pair.

input.zh: questions_survive_encoding 在每个左右接续问题消费 operation_lifts，并递归保持逻辑联结。
input.en: questions_survive_encoding consumes operation_lifts at every left/right successor question and recursively preserves the logical constructors.

conditions.zh: 同一 J、编码、有限纤维、Exact、Reduced 完整保留。
conditions.en: The same J, encoding, finite fibers, Exact and Reduced are retained.

detail.zh: 不同载体的保留引用形成对应已在新范围内实查；不是回写本结果的证明范围。
detail.en: Retained-reference formation across different carriers is checked at its new scope; it does not rewrite this result’s proof scope.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究中的接续成果；具体正式复用另列，关联不自动构成已证转换。
detail.en: Continuation result in the same study; formal reuse is listed separately, and this relationship does not itself assert a checked adapter.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 同一研究的新接续；具体形式复用另列，此关联不独自证明转换。
detail.en: New continuation in the same study; formal reuse is specified separately, without a proved adapter inferred from this relation.

detail.zh: 涵盖有限否定、合取及接续的语义，不证明检验装置形成、实际负面证据或所有问题已取得。
detail.en: Covers semantics of finite negation, conjunction and continuation; it does not establish apparatus formation, actual negative evidence or acquired access to all questions.

limitations.zh: 涵盖有限否定、合取及接续的语义，不证明检验装置形成、实际负面证据或所有问题已取得。
limitations.en: Covers semantics of finite negation, conjunction and continuation; it does not establish apparatus formation, actual negative evidence or acquired access to all questions.

validation_scope.zh: 所列 Lean 源码与成功冻结回执逐字哈希绑定；本轮223项审计含26项新声明。旧功能性定理信用此前166项回执，未冒充新证明。
validation_scope.en: Listed Lean sources bind by exact hash to successful frozen receipts. This round checks 223 declarations including 26 new ones. The older functional theorem credits its previous 166-audit receipt, not a new proof.

next_delta.zh: 复用有限条件程序与真实余项恢复；继续建立内部语法不同的说明之间余项、判断与实际形成关系的有据翻译，区分语义可判定与实际取得。
next_delta.en: Reuse finite guarded programs and coherent residual recovery; establish warranted residual/guard/formation translation between descriptions with different internal syntax, distinguishing semantic tests from actual acquisition.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I3（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。新的核心模块 Becoming.Joining（只导入 Becoming.Likeness）把片段的结合经伙伴、角色与保留引用读作脊柱的框架；描述提升一结合，恰当同一编码是伙伴框架的互模拟，无前提（Joining.lifts_iff）；Becoming.JoiningBridge 把结合研究读作实例。描述提升结合处，每一分支检验经描述保留（Joining.holds_image_iff）；外围的分支问题即伙伴框架的分支检验，往返一一对应（ofQuestion、toQuestion）。外围的 questions_survive_encoding 在脊柱上成立（Joining.questions_survive_encoding_of_em），排中律作为具名假设 em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p，只用于在结果已列出时把通过相同分支检验认同为相同，即外围用经典推理之处；无此假设时，提升恰是同一编码为互模拟（Joining.operation_lifts_iff）。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. Where a description lifts the joining, every branching test survives it (Joining.holds_image_iff); the periphery's branch questions are the partner frame's branching tests, read one to one (ofQuestion, toQuestion). The periphery's questions_survive_encoding holds on the spine (Joining.questions_survive_encoding_of_em): excluded middle is named as the hypothesis em : ∀ p : Prop, Decided p and used only to identify passing the same branching tests with likeness where outcomes are listed, which is where the periphery reasoned classically; without it, lifting is exactly having one code being a bisimulation (Joining.operation_lifts_iff). Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
